messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: SLO breach detected — streaming p99 latency > 5s in us-west-2 for routing-group:streaming-primary. Automated paging triggered. :rotating_light:
Sam (oncall): seeing it. p95 looks okay but p99 is climbing. Confirming impact on streaming sessions (stalls + partial responses).
Priya (sre): jumping in. Any recent deploys?
Sam (oncall): no deploys in the last hour, console shows spike around 1873000000. Routing shows increased retries and unfinished chunks.
Nia (ml-runtime): pulling traces for a few sessions — I see stalls during kv-cache loads and large step times at token emission.
Miguel (infra): checking node health — getting ECC error spikes on gpu-node-uw2-17 and thermal events on gpu-node-uw2-18.
InfraBot: gpu-node-uw2-17: ECC_ERRORS=43 in last 5m; gpu-node-uw2-18: THERMAL_THROTTLE=1, FAN_SPEED_WARNING.
Sam (oncall): can we isolate those two nodes from the serving pool?
Miguel (infra): initiating drain of uw2-17 and uw2-18 now. Setting weight=0 for serving router, starting evict.
Priya (sre): how many active streams are on those nodes? Need estimate for customer impact.
Miguel (infra): approx 320 active streaming sessions, estimate ~7% of traffic for this shard.
Nia (ml-runtime): logs from a stalled stream:```
[stream_id=abc123] token_index=127 emit_time=4823ms last_kv_load=4600ms
model=redwood-optimized-v1 batch_size=1 device=gpu-node-uw2-17
error_log: cuda: uncorrectable_ecc at driver.c:142
```
Sam (oncall): uncorrectable ECC is bad — might be causing kernel hangs and stalls.
Priya (sre): mitigation plan: 1) drain nodes 2) route traffic to dedicated fallback pool 3) reduce max concurrency per-device to lower stress 4) enable soft-fallback to cpu for long tails? Thoughts?
Miguel (infra): doing 1) and 2) now. Routing rule update in progress: route streaming-primary -> fallback-dedicated if node health < 0.8.
InfraBot: routing-rule-change: applied in 12s. Current fallback pool capacity: 120% spare.
Nia (ml-runtime): for 3) lowering concurrency on remaining uw2 devices from 8->4 to reduce queueing. Applying config change.
Sam (oncall): Priya, can we throttle batching as well? Large batches exacerbate thermal load.
Priya (sre): yes — set max_batch_tokens to 512 and disable large-batch packing for streaming routes.
Miguel (infra): drain completed for uw2-17 and uw2-18. Evicted sessions failed over to fallback pool; seeing error rate drop.
Sam (oncall): monitoring p99... it's dropping from ~6.2s -> 1.3s in 2 min. Good sign.
Priya (sre): marking incident as "mitigated" for customer-facing comms, but keep investigating root cause.
Nia (ml-runtime): note: we saw some sessions reattempting with idempotent retries which amplified load briefly — we should throttle retry rate in edge to avoid retry storms.
Sam (oncall): can we put short-term retry backoff to exponential with jitter and max 2 retries?
Miguel (infra): applied retry-policy change at the edge config.
Priya (sre): collecting additional telemetry: kernel oops, GPU ECC counts, and thermal logs. Also requesting vendor RMA for gpu-node-uw2-17 (uncorrectable ECC).
InfraBot: rma-ticket created: RMA-8921 for gpu-node-uw2-17.
Priya (sre): assigning follow-up: postmortem owner = Sam (oncall). Will add timeline, signals, and mitigation steps.
Sam (oncall): handing off to Priya for deeper root-cause and hardware coordination. My shift ends in 25m. Priya, taking it?
Priya (sre): taking handoff — I'll stay on until root cause tracked and hardware vendor confirms RMA timeline.
Nia (ml-runtime): quick config note for postmortem: add KV-cache eviction on ECC-detected flag, consider automatic micro-drain on ECC spike threshold.
Miguel (infra): also propose automated thermal smoothing: reduce perf state when temp > threshold to avoid uncorrectable errors.
Priya (sre): customer impact assessment: approx 320 active streaming sessions impacted; we saw increased user retries and ~40 timed-out client sessions. No confirmed data loss. Affected customers flagged: two enterprise tenants (acct-789, acct-414) experienced timeouts — success rate recovered after failover.
Sam (oncall): notifying support to prepare templated comms for affected enterprise accounts.
PagerDuty: NOTE: on-call handoff recorded. Primary responder: Sam (oncall) -> secondary: Priya (sre).
Priya (sre): next steps: 1) finish collecting logs and attach to postmortem 2) vendor RMA and hardware swap for uw2-17 3) implement quick-fixes (retry backoff, batch caps, route fallback) as durable platform changes 4) consider alert threshold tuning to detect ECC spike before SLO breach.
Sam (oncall): thanks team. I'll post a short incident summary and escalate if anything regresses.
Priya (sre): closing thread for now, will update postmortem link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
